checkedAlternates.resolution: Flame Over Circle specifically denotes physical oxidizing fire/intensification hazard (group-3), not direct biological health toxicity (group-4).
Corrosion is grouped with acute/chronic tissue and health-damage pictograms (group-4) rather than combustion/explosion hazards (group-3).
